notes.content:
Crashing the ship became more appealing. You get to stroll the outside world a watch the ship crash.

Fixed some minor issues.

notes.title: Update 0.570: Major update with retro 3D graphics mode!
notes.content:
What if the game was made in 1990? It might have looked similar to this new graphics mode.
Low vertex precision, low-resolution unfiltered textures, fog to disguise the viewing distance, limited color palette, loading disruptions and so forth. There is a certain appeal to this PS1 look. It’s like 3D pixel art :)

Other changes:
[list]
    [*]There now is an audio sub-menu to control the volume for the effects and the voice over.
[*]Fixed a bug that cause the unlockable, Irish voice over setting to disappear.
[*]Some general polishing throughout the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31531987/42103b8c6877caa15a61c6fa45c27f2352362055.jpg[/img]

tags.feature: There now is an audio sub-menu to control the volume for the effects and the voice over.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug that cause the unlockable, Irish voice over setting to disappear.

notes.title: Update 0.557: Irish dubbing
notes.content:
The Irish, not so serious alternative dubbing is in the game!
Enjoy it, if you can find out how XD
The Axe moved again, it’s now visible on the back of the yellow machine. You still need to get there somehow.
And some other tweaks and improvements.

[*]Improving an issue of the macOS version that causes the camera to jump after leaving a menu.

notes.title: Update 0.527
notes.content:
Quite a few changes done:

[list]
    [*]Interactive objects will now lose their highlighting if there is nothing left to do.
It might have been confusing to some players before.

[*]A simple tutorial page will be shown to new players or after resetting the game. I hope this will prevent players from trying to click on anything in the game.

[*]If you have progressed in the game, you won’t see the intro anymore when launching the game.

[*]Gamepad sensitivity reduced. You can still change it within the game.

[*]Hint delay decreased.

[*]Fixed a bug in the inventory that caused the text to disappear after switching between languages.

[*]Fixed a bug that caused the elevator to jump if the player was hammering the button.

Awesome German voice actors made it into the game.

notes.title: Update 0.494
notes.content:
And even more changes after the weekend:

Adding a small detail to help convey the concept of the game. 
Every time you start the game or respawn after dying, a night counter will be shown. The initial night count will be random if there is no save game yet or if you choose to reset the game. However, it will be counting up throughout the game.

In addition to that, I have added some more text bits to several areas.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31531987/3b8960ac686b623488fc4b2b846b79cbe1b5afce.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.454
notes.content:
Fixes since 0.452:

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the default language to be German.
[*]Resetting the game resets all achievement related values in the game. You will not lose the achievements in Steam.
[*]Items will be removed, if already in the inventory, the next time you load the game.
[*]Some colliders increased in size to make them easier to find.
[*]The spherical controller connected to the ray gun will not deflect the ray anymore. The puzzle can be solved that way, but it is very fiddly. Please use something else XD
[*]The game is not over after you get shot. The game now reloads at the previous checkpoint to make it more obvious
[*]The invert axis option now also works for the mouse axis, not just the gamepad
[/list]

tags.bug: -Fixed a bug that caused the default language to be German.
-The spherical controller connected to the ray gun will not deflect the ray anymore. The puzzle can be solved that way, but it is very fiddly. Please use something else XD
- The game is not over after you get shot. The game now reloads at the previous checkpoint to make it more obvious

tags.feature: - The invert axis option now also works for the mouse axis, not just the gamepad

tags.balance_change: - Some colliders increased in size to make them easier to find.

notes.title: Update 0.452
notes.content:
When using mouse and keyboard, entering the menu with the escape key was possible, but leaving it was not. Hitting escape again, would quit the game. This bug was cause by a change made for android, to always react to the back button.
And no, it's not time to create a branch just yet :)

Other fixes:
Resetting the game state during the running game, when executing "reset game". No need to restart.

Avoiding to save the player's location on moving platforms. They might end up in a different position next time you load the game.
